name: Discount Moulding
old_description: At Discount Moulding, we specialize in providing high-quality interior doors and moulding at unbeatable prices. Whether you’re looking for baseboards, casing, or flat stock, our streamlined product selection makes it easy to find the right fit for your project. We keep things simple offering only what our customers truly need, without overwhelming options or inflated prices.
about:
Discount Moulding operates from its headquarters in Halethorpe, Maryland, and runs five showrooms across Chicago, Charlotte, Baltimore, Tysons Corner, and Charleston. The family-owned company was built on a volume-based model, purchasing moulding and interior doors by the truckload to keep prices low.

The company’s core service is in-house pre-hanging of doors, allowing customization of size, swing direction, jamb width, hinge color, and other specifications. It maintains a curated inventory of baseboards, casing, crown, shoe, flat stock, and interior doors, with most popular profiles available for next-day pickup or delivery from its showrooms.

Discount Moulding serves residential and light commercial builders, contractors, homeowners, and interior designers. Testimonials cite projects ranging from single-family remodels to a 30-unit apartment renovation, with designers noting the Craftsman and Colonial profiles as go-to choices for clients.

The business emphasizes its family-owned, customer-driven approach, combining truckload purchasing power with in-house pre-hanging to deliver quality trim and doors without markup. Fast availability, honest pricing, and personalized support are presented as the primary differentiators.
